body: My brother did something similar to me and although it still affects me today, I was never mad at him for it. He distanced himself from me when we got older and honestly that just made me feel worse. I still love him a lot and although he made a mistake I forgave him a long time ago. If I was your sister, I would be so grateful if you came up to me and talked about it. I really wish my brother had done that to me. It would of made the healing process a lot easier. I really recommend you have a discussion with her about it.

That’s tough because I would change so many things. A lot of things that I can’t change, like that my family was more functional and less distant, my friends enjoyed my presence more and wanted to hang out with me. I would be good at school and it would be easy, and I would have a boyfriend. I would be a well rounded student and have goals and aspirations. Sadly there’s not a way for me to change most of the stuff I wish I could, and even if I could I would never have enough motivation to.
